
{{alias}}( a, b )
    Tests whether two 64-bit unsigned integers are equal.

    Parameters
    ----------
    a: Uint64
        First 64-bit unsigned integer.

    b: Uint64
        Second 64-bit unsigned integer.

    Returns
    -------
    out: boolean
        Result.

    Examples
    --------
    > var a = new {{alias:@stdlib/number/uint64/ctor}}( 1234 );
    > var b = {{alias:@stdlib/number/uint64/ctor}}.of( 0, 1234 );
    > var v = {{alias}}( a, b )
    true


{{alias}}.words( ah, al, bh, bl )
    Tests whether two 64-bit unsigned integers are equal using word comparison.

    Parameters
    ----------
    ah: integer
        High 32-bit word of the first 64-bit unsigned integer.

    al: integer
        Low 32-bit word of the first 64-bit unsigned integer.

    bh: integer
        High 32-bit word of the second 64-bit unsigned integer.

    bl: integer
        Low 32-bit word of the second 64-bit unsigned integer.

    Returns
    -------
    out: boolean
        Result.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}.words( 0, 5, 0, 5 )
    true
    > v = {{alias}}.words( 0, 5, 0, 10 )
    false


{{alias}}.strided( a, strideA, offsetA, b, strideB, offsetB )
    Tests whether two 64-bit unsigned integers stored in integer-valued strided
    array views are equal.

    Parameters
    ----------
    a: ArrayLikeObject
        First 64-bit unsigned integer strided array view containing interleaved
        32-bit unsigned integer high and low order words.

    strideA: integer
        Stride length for `a`.

    offsetA: integer
        Starting index for `a`.

    b: ArrayLikeObject
        Second 64-bit unsigned integer strided array view containing interleaved
        32-bit unsigned integer high and low order words.

    strideB: integer
        Stride length for `b`.

    offsetB: integer
        Starting index for `b`.

    Returns
    -------
    out: boolean
        Result.

    Examples
    --------
    > var a = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint32}}( [ 0, 5 ] );
    > var b = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint32}}( [ 0, 5 ] );
    > var v = {{alias}}.strided( a, 1, 0, b, 1, 0 )
    true
    > b = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint32}}( [ 0, 10 ] );
    > v = {{alias}}.strided( a, 1, 0, b, 1, 0 )
    false

    See Also
    --------
